decisions.why: examples are an ICP-MS analyser platform and its hardware — EPA 200.8 Water Analyzer, Instrument Parts for ICP-MS, ICP-MS Control Pack — analyser equipment, matching the precedent set for Molecular Spectroscopy and Cell Analysis

examples are HPLC instrument hardware and its instrument-management software — 1290 Multicolumn Thermostat (an LC stack module), DAD/MWD Supplies for HPLC (detector hardware), Lab Advisor Software (instrument diagnostics) — an instrument platform, as with Molecular Spectroscopy

two of the three examples are classic GC consumables (Graphite Ferrules for GC, Dimpled Liners for GC) and the third is an inlet/detector part; this sits with the supplier's GC Columns division already mapped to pathology:consum

the products are reagent kits — Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity DNA Analysis Kit and High Sensitivity Protein Analysis Kit — with the Fragment Analyzer Software being the run software for them; kits are laboratory consumables, as with the Real-Time PCR division

all three examples are column-based chemistries — Glycan Analysis Columns, AdvanceBio Glycan Mapping, Charge Variant Analysis — i.e. HPLC columns and their application chemistries, laboratory consumables

the products are library-preparation reagent kits — SureSelectXT RNA Direct Library Preparation Kit, Magnis SureSelect XT HS2 DNA Reagent Kit — laboratory consumables; the third example is the analysis service that accompanies them
all three examples are analytical reference standards (Food & Beverages Standards, EPA/States Standards, Amino & Nitro Aromatics Standards) — reagents consumed in laboratory analysis
the lead example is the 6475 Triple Quadrupole LC-MS, an analyser, with LC-MS Supplies & Accessories being its instrument hardware — an analyser platform
both examples are labware consumed in dissolution runs — Dissolution Baskets and Dissolution Vials, Tubes & Trays — laboratory consumables, not the dissolution apparatus itself
